mapper.sql: r.id, r.account_id, a.username, r.file_name, r.file_size, r.char_count, r.duration_ms, r.status, r.failure_reason, r.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocr_record (account_id, file_name, file_size, char_count, duration_ms, status, failure_reason) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{charCount}, #{durationMs}, #{status}, #{failureReason})
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.char_count), 0) AS totalCharCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(r.duration_ms, 0))), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM ocr_record r
AND r.created_at >= CONCAT(#{start}, ' 00:00:00') AND r.created_at <= CONCAT(#{end}, ' 23:59:59')
